Control Relations

Every build-relevant control in the game — all 288 of them, in the menu's own order — against the PlayStyles that flare on it, the attributes that decide how it goes, and the perks it fires. No inputs here; the combos live on the controls pages. Celebrations are the one omission: they carry no build relation. The gaps are the point.
